The signal rises gradually, sustains through ~575, but no opposing return is observed before index 610. The absence of a clear reversal prevents confirmation of a temporary offset; status is uncertain. The candidate jump at 567 aligns with onset but does not define interval boundaries—onset is better judged by sustained deviation from background, not a single point.
